title: 第21章 神兽择主（求追读）
novel_title: 恶毒女配又装纯，禁欲大佬皆沦陷
content_zh:
和铃怎么可能变心呢？

    这么多年了，不管夜弦对她如何冷漠无情，和铃都是眼巴巴地捧着宝物自己求着夜弦收的。

    她觉得夜弦被和铃感动的可能性都比和铃变心的可能性大。

    反正梁秋儿是不相信自己妹妹的话的。

    小麒麟歪着脑袋打了个哈欠。

    圆润的水灵灵的眼睛偷瞄了和铃一眼。

    这些天的晚上，一直有南华宗的弟子来给它送吃的，但它却再也没有见到和铃。

    她是不想得到自己的青睐了吗？

    居然只讨好它一次就不来了。

    哼。

    待会儿它一定要吓唬吓唬她。

    小麒麟这样想着，脸上露出一丝鬼鬼祟祟的微笑。

    “你们看，小麒麟居然笑了。”

    “它不会要选择程芰荷了吧？”

    “小麒麟糊涂啊！程芰荷无才无貌，现在又和凡人无异，它怎么会看上程芰荷呢？”

    “肯定是那颗麒麟果起作用了，夜弦师弟的无情道不会要破了吧？不然他怎么会给程芰荷麒麟果，让她讨得小麒麟欢心呢？”

    “麒麟果是夜师弟和梁师姐从秘境中带回来的，总共都没有几颗，夜师弟能把麒麟果让给程芰荷，还不能说明什么吗？”

    “真是没想到，宗门里面这么多的女弟子，居然都输给了程芰荷，显得和铃这些年的死皮赖脸甚是可笑啊！”

    和铃好烦。

    这些人能不能不要老是提以前的事情了。

    原身喜欢过夜弦真要成她一辈子的污点了。

    可恶啊。

    好想给大家都灌一点失去记忆的药。

    程芰荷感觉到小麒麟有些在发呆，都没有听她说什么。

    但小麒麟收下了她的麒麟果，歪着脑袋咬了起来。

    她回头看了眼小麒麟，茫然地下了台。

    姜暮烟上台前，和铃给她打气，“师姐加油，你能行的！”
content_en:
"Does that mean you have Taiqing Jade Liquid?" He Ling's eyes lit up and she asked happily.

As for the large amount of wealth Xiao Yi mentioned, she didn't take it to heart. With the Changtian Diagram, she couldn't be short of money.

The dog-licking system said in a panic: [He Ling, I also have Taiqing Jade Liquid, and I don’t charge you any money. You just need to complete the task...]

"Why are you everywhere? Let's go."

He Ling's dislike of the dog-licking system is palpable.

Over the past few days, she has gradually understood the essence of the two systems.

The dog-licking system requires her to maintain the dog-licking character, and increase the system level through the dog-licking points she obtains from completing tasks to achieve the purpose of "ascension".

The trading system should have its own reward pool, but due to certain restrictions, it cannot swallow the rewards in the reward pool itself.

It can only swallow the energy of items exchanged through trade and strengthen itself.

Maybe the number of transactions is also something it pursues.

Xiao Yi can swallow the energy of the dog-licking system, provided that the level of the dog-licking system cannot be too much higher than it.

Since she has done several dog-licking tasks recently, it is obvious that Xiao Yi can no longer swallow the dog-licking system.

That's fine, let the two of them control each other and compete for the upper hand, so that she can get what she wants at the minimum cost.

He Ling asked smoothly: "Gouzi, do you really have Taiqing Jade Liquid?"

Didn’t we say that Taiqing Jade Liquid is a rare treasure?

How could Xiao Yi and Gouzi treat her like cabbage?

The dog-licking system vowed: [Absolutely.He Ling, when did I lie to you?】

"Then who knows." He Ling said casually, "I'm not the roundworm in your belly. I don't know you lied to me."

Dog licking system: [...]

What about the most basic trust between people and systems?

[He Ling, we are not enemies, but a community of interests. I will not lie to you.】The dog-licking system strives to prove itself.

[Well, let me show you the world of the system.After reading it, you will know how sincere I am.】

The world of systems?

He Ling was full of anticipation and curiosity.

The next second, her consciousness came to a void space.

suddenly.

Groups of spiritual lights lit up, like stars in the sky.

The sound of the dog-licking system sounded from the void.

[These auras are all prizes awarded by the system. Of course, there are more treasures hidden in the darkness on the periphery, which I cannot pry at the moment.】

[He Ling, do you see the aura at the top?】

[Use your consciousness to feel it, there is Taiqing Jade Liquid inside.】

The moment He Ling's consciousness came into contact with the spiritual light, he felt that his whole person was purified.

Such a clean smell.

After regaining consciousness, He Ling suddenly found that his body had calmed down.
